author: kpedro88
body:
This PR introduces a separate case for extra PR testing WFs (GPU, profiling) for 20_1_X to move the workflow numbers to D128, corresponding to https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51935.

Once that cmssw PR is merged, another PR will be made to cms-bot to update the 20_0_X workflows also to D128 (corresponding to the backport https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51936). At that point, the two separate cases in this script can be collapsed back into one case.

Updating these manually is suboptimal and should be automated: see #2853.
title: move to D128 WFs for 20_1_X
